title: agent settings
description: ~/.agents/settings.json, edited by /settings. A missing or invalid value falls back to its default.

default_model.description: Model each start and /clear begin on; when set, /model picks last until /clear and are not saved.

default_thinking.description: Thinking level each start and /clear begin on; when set, thinking changes last until /clear and are not saved.

speed.description: Faster output at a higher price: Anthropic speed fast (ultrafast counts as fast), OpenAI Codex service_tier priority or ultrafast.

cache_ttl.description: Anthropic prompt cache lifetime; 1h writes cost more.

reviewer_model.description: Model for the auto-mode reviewer; empty means the provider's small model.

reserve_tokens.description: Context tokens kept free for the answer; compaction starts before they run out.

footer_cost.description: Show the session's cost in the footer: what OpenRouter billed, else the tokens at list prices.

footer_account.description: Show the name of the account in use before the model in the footer.

context_windows.description: Keyed by provider ("anthropic") or model ("anthropic/claude-opus-5-5"); the model key wins.

provider_sort.description: Order of the provider lists in /account, the context windows panel and web search.

provider_order.description: Providers listed first when provider_sort is manual; the rest keep their default order after them.

pinned_models.description: Models, as provider/id, the model picker lists first and Ctrl+P switches between, in order.

conflict_priority.description: Which skill or prompt wins when the project's .agents and ~/.agents have one with the same name.

approved_mcp.description: Project .mcp.json servers allowed to run, approved with space in /mcp.

trusted_projects.description: Project roots whose .agents files load and whose edit hooks run, set with /trust.

headroom.description: Route model requests through a headroom proxy.

headroom_url.description: A remote headroom proxy, e.g. https://headroom.example.com. Empty uses the local one.

headroom_token.description: The remote headroom proxy's HEADROOM_PROXY_TOKEN, sent as x-headroom-proxy-token.

headroom_env.description: Environment of the headroom service, e.g. HEADROOM_DISABLE_KOMPRESS. At start the agent reinstalls the service with `headroom install apply --env` when a value differs. Removing a key does not unset it: set it to the value you want instead. HEADROOM_TOOL_SEARCH is 0 unless set here, because headroom's tool search hides the agent's edit tools behind a search step. HEADROOM_HOST and HEADROOM_PORT are refused, because the agent always uses 127.0.0.1:8787.

progress_bar.description: Show the terminal's busy indicator (OSC 9;4) while the agent works.

prune_sessions.description: Delete saved sessions untouched this long, at start.

mid_turn.description: A message sent while the agent works: steering reaches the model at its next tool call, queued waits for the turn to end and runs as the next prompt.

on_start.description: Shell commands the TUI runs in the background at start.

custom_providers.description: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions or Anthropic-compatible Messages endpoints. Models show as <name>/<model id>. A preset name (README lists them, e.g. ollama, groq, deepseek) fills in base_url and api_key_env.

name.description: Not anthropic, openai-codex or openrouter, and without a slash.

api_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the key; empty sends no key.

api.description: openai sends Chat Completions to {base_url}/chat/completions; anthropic sends Messages to {base_url}/v1/messages with x-api-key.

lsp.description: Language name to the server that checks a file after each edit. Built in: typescript, rust, swift, go, python, cpp, php. A field you leave out keeps its built-in value; a new name adds a language.

command.description: Program and arguments, split on spaces. An empty string turns the language off.

roots.description: Files that mark a project root; the server starts in the nearest directory above the file that has one.

model.description: Empty means the default summarizer for the provider.
Model for a subagent call that names none; empty means the parent's.

switch_at_percent.description: Switch accounts when the fuller usage window reaches this percent. 0 never switches.

fallback_model.description: Model on another provider for other-provider. When set, a request that still fails with 5xx, 529 or a network error after its retries also moves to it. Empty means the other provider's default model and no failover.

default.description: Provider to account name, used first while under the limit.
